m.t: Tengo mi parte justa de los problemas, pero estoy trabajando en ello.
m.e: I have my fair share of issues, but I'm working on it.

m.t: Una justa advertencia, sin embargo, tiene un final triste.
m.e: Fair warning though, it has a sad ending.

m.t: Para ser justa, no tienes la pinta de la gente habitual.
m.e: To be fair, you don't look the usual type.

m.t: También ha habido una parte justa de la mala suerte.
m.e: There's also been a fair share of bad luck.

m.t: Todo lo que quiero es una pelea justa.
m.e: All I want is a fair fight.

m.t: Él trata a la gente de manera justa.
m.e: He deals fairly with people.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2884287 by cueyayotl; English translation #300108 by CM

m.t: Haremos la ceremonia de forma justa y dejaremos que el destino decida.
m.e: We do the ceremony the right way and let fate decide.

m.t: La maestra fue muy justa cuando calificó nuestros exámenes.
m.e: The teacher was very fair when she marked our exams.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #642150 by darinmex; English translation #272913 by CK

m.t: Damos gracias a la tierra, madre de todo, por su recompensa buena y justa.
m.e: We give thanks to the earth, mother of all, for her fine, fair bounty.

m.t: Crees que no he sido justa contigo.
m.e: You think I have not been fair to you.

m.t: En realidad, no es una pelea justa.
m.e: Not really a fair fight.

m.t: Siempre ha sido así. Pero, a cambio, ofrece su bendición justa.
m.e: That has always been His way, but He gives the righteous blessings in return.

m.t: Tiene razón, fue una pelea justa.
m.e: He's right, it was a fair fight.

m.t: Esa no fue una pelea justa.
m.e: It wasn't a fair fight.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4036744 by Gabu; English translation #4035893 by Hybrid

m.t: La ley no siempre es justa.
m.e: The law is not always fair.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2240472 by marcelostockle; English translation #321017 by CC

m.t: Esa no es una pregunta justa.
m.e: That's not a fair question.

m.t: La vida no es justa.
m.e: Life isn't fair.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1902241 by alexmarcelo; English translation #1130691 by Scott

m.t: Nunca es una lucha justa.
m.e: It's never a fair fight.

m.t: Sé que intentaste ser justa.
m.e: I know you tried to be fair.

m.t: Fue una lucha justa.
m.e: It was a fair fight.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5567220 by swyter; English translation #3428330 by CK

m.t: Lo suficientemente lejos de nosotros la gente justa.
m.e: - Far enough away from us righteous folk.

m.t: Cuando vemos que nuestra causa es justa, lágrimas vienen a nuestros ojos.
m.e: When we see that our cause is just, tears come to our eyes.

m.t: Pero yo creía que mi causa también era justa.
m.e: But I believed that my cause was righteous, too.

m.t: Y que nos dice la cantidad justa de la verdad para ocultar las mentiras.
m.e: And telling us just the right amount of truth to hide the lies.

m.t: Cuando la ley no es justa, la justicia triunfa sobre la ley.
m.e: When the law isn't just, justice trumps the law.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10107358 by carlosalberto; English translation #9405046 by Nylez

m.t: Ella cree que su causa es justa.
m.e: She believes her cause to be just.

m.t: Creo que la decisión es justa.
m.e: I believe that the decision is just.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2266893 by cueyayotl; English translation #2266892 by _undertoad

m.t: El pecado más grave, ya que te aleja de la justa gloria de Dios.
m.e: The most serious sin because it steals away from God's righteous glory.

m.t: Pero somos cinco veces más grandes que ustedes.
m.e: But we're five times your size.

m.t: Tus ojos son más grandes que tu estómago.
m.e: Your eyes are bigger than your stomach.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1358463 by marcelostockle; English translation #324950 by CK

m.t: Les he dicho que tienes unas pelotas muy grandes, pero no tan grandes.
m.e: I told them you got big balls, but not that big.

m.t: Aquí todos somos grandes fans de tu música.
m.e: We're all big fans of your music around here.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5015970 by Mavry; English translation #5014238 by \N

m.t: Hay grandes tiendas en el centro de la ciudad.
m.e: There are big shops in the city center.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #11224243 by carlosalberto; English translation #11224239 by carlosalberto

m.t: Siempre hay problemas después de medianoche en las grandes ciudades.
m.e: There is always trouble after midnight in big cities.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1615343 by marcelostockle; English translation #866323 by \N

m.t: ¿Tiene este par de zapatos en tallas más grandes?
m.e: Do you have this pair of shoes in bigger sizes?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #11321974 by carlosalberto; English translation #11321955 by carlosalberto

m.t: Él tiene la capacidad de llevar a cabo grandes planes.
m.e: He has the ability to carry out big plans.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9678905 by Eremon; English translation #284875 by CM

m.t: A todos les gustan las pizzas grandes.
m.e: Everyone likes big pizzas.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1458446 by marcelostockle; English translation #1242093 by CM

m.t: El rey le impuso grandes impuestos a la gente.
m.e: The king imposed heavy taxes on the people.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1273901 by marcelostockle; English translation #25634 by CK

m.t: Fue un mes de grandes cuentas, Bow.
m.e: It was a big month, Bow.

m.t: - Sin duda he visto más grandes.
m.e: - I've definitely seen bigger.

m.t: En China hay muchas ciudades grandes.
m.e: In China, there are a lot of big cities.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12958300 by Borbie; English translation #12956460 by rul

m.t: Los pequeños secretos crean grandes mentiras.
m.e: Small secrets make big lies.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #853635 by japegon; English translation #852974 by LittleBoy

m.t: Tiene unas manos grandes.
m.e: He has big hands.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2242032 by Shishir; English translation #299184 by CK

m.t: Estos perros son grandes.
m.e: These dogs are big.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #503578 by Shishir; English translation #55306 by CK

m.t: Estos coches son grandes.
m.e: These cars are big.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6948544 by maaster; English translation #55194 by CK

m.t: Hay muchas estrellas más grandes que nuestro sol.
m.e: There exist several stars which are larger than our Sun.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2088970 by marcelostockle; English translation #863957 by Eldad

m.t: Muchos hombres tienen pechos más grandes que las mujeres.
m.e: Many men have larger breasts than women.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1917427 by hayastan; English translation #1702527 by Spamster

m.t: Londres es una de las ciudades más grandes del mundo.
m.e: London is one of the largest cities in the world.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #591189 by darinmex; English translation #29266 by Zifre

m.t: Ella tiene unos grandes ojos azules.
m.e: She has large blue eyes.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #867526 by felipeselles; English translation #315668 by CK

m.t: Las casas grandes son costosas para vivir.
m.e: Large houses are expensive to live in.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1195821 by marcelostockle; English translation #275498 by CK

m.t: Él solo tiene veintiséis años y ya dirige grandes compañías.
m.e: He is only twenty-six years old and already managing large companies.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1745317 by marcelostockle; English translation #1745257 by kate15

m.t: Les gustaban los coches grandes.
m.e: They liked large cars.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #743185 by darinmex; English translation #307099 by CK

m.t: Leer es uno de los grandes placeres de la vida.
m.e: Reading is one of life's great pleasures.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1747890 by teskmon; English translation #1269257 by CM

m.t: A fin de lograr grandes cosas, debemos vivir como si nunca fuéramos a morir.
m.e: In order to achieve great things, we must live as though we are never going to die.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1702260 by teskmon; English translation #879641 by Scott

m.t: Todavía no estamos listos para volver a casa.
m.e: We aren't ready to go home yet.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #13649320 by mervert1; English translation #7520036 by CK

m.t: ¿Estamos listos para arriesgar nuestras vidas por esto?
m.e: Are we ready to risk our lives for that?

m.t: Creo que estamos listos para ir allí.
m.e: I think we're ready to go there.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5674460 by arh; English translation #5671883 by CK

m.t: Deberíamos estar listos para lo que venga.
m.e: We ought to be ready for whatever comes.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6627312 by UsuarioX; English translation #25129 by CK

m.t: Creo que estamos listos para dar ejemplo.
m.e: I think we're ready to set an example.

m.t: ¿Estáis listos para el juego de hoy?
m.e: Are you ready for today's game?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10726232 by SeaLiteral; English translation #3824455 by CK

m.t: Tenéis que estar listos para cualquier cosa.
m.e: You need to be ready for anything.

m.t: Los soldados están listos para la batalla.
m.e: The soldiers are ready for battle.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #628648 by Dejo; English translation #320109 by CK

m.t: Está bien, ¿cuánto tiempo antes de que estas unidades están listos para el combate?
m.e: Okay, how long before these units are ready for combat?

m.t: ¿Todos están listos para el viaje?
m.e: Is everybody ready for the trip?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1702705 by marcelostockle; English translation #32080 by CK

m.t: Debemos estar listos para cualquier cosa.
m.e: We must be ready for anything.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4769182 by alegarvid; English translation #2642838 by CK

m.t: Ellos estaban listos para la acción.
m.e: They were ready for action.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1387746 by marcelostockle; English translation #802193 by Source_VOA

m.t: No estamos listos para hacerlo.
m.e: We're not ready to do that.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4153600 by mervert1; English translation #2953930 by CK

m.t: No estábamos listos para esto.
m.e: We weren't ready for this.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9466330 by hayastan; English translation #9466331 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Estamos casi listos para empezar.
m.e: We're, uh, almost ready to start.

m.t: Ya estamos listos para usted.
m.e: We're ready for you now.

m.t: Los prototipos todavía no están listos.
m.e: The prototypes are not yet ready.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10365074 by Seael; English translation #11073878 by nickitolas

m.t: Debemos estar listos para marcharnos.
m.e: We must be ready to leave.

m.t: Estamos listos para ayudar.
m.e: We're ready to help.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5488024 by Mar1L; English translation #5487168 by CK

m.t: Estamos listos para jugar.
m.e: We're ready to play.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5488020 by Mar1L; English translation #5487180 by CK

m.t: Estamos listos para irnos.
m.e: We're ready to go.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3807986 by Shishir; English translation #1981525 by Spamster

m.t: Creo que estamos listos.
m.e: I think we're ready.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5493296 by ecorralest101; English translation #4980148 by CK

m.t: ¿Están todos ustedes listos?
m.e: Are you all ready?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #726512 by Fanki; English translation #63266 by CK

m.t: Estamos listos para escuchar.
m.e: We're ready to listen.

m.t: Estamos listos para partir.
m.e: We're ready to leave.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #496808 by Shishir; English translation #66182 by CK

m.t: ¿Estáis listos para jugar?
m.e: Are you ready to play?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4353970 by mervert1; English translation #2050566 by CK

m.t: ¿Estáis listos para comer?
m.e: Are you ready to eat?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2455560 by Shishir; English translation #32246 by CK

m.t: Estamos listos para continuar.
m.e: We're ready to move on.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5022682 by don_ramon; English translation #5020116 by CK

m.t: ¿Estáis listos para volar?
m.e: Are you ready to fly?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4290983 by mervert1; English translation #1216885 by CM

m.t: Tom y yo estamos listos.
m.e: Tom and I are ready.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #13358420 by Shishir; English translation #6274606 by CK

m.t: Mi padre todavía no ha llegado a casa.
m.e: My father is not home yet.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #638548 by darinmex; English translation #251651 by Liface

m.t: Bueno, por lo que puedo decir, hemos llegado.
m.e: Well, as far as I can tell, we're here.

m.t: ¿Me vas a decir cómo ha llegado esto aquí?
m.e: You wanna tell me how this got over here?

m.t: Tras tres horas de discusión no habíamos llegado a ninguna parte.
m.e: After three hours of discussion we got nowhere.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #576228 by darinmex; English translation #72689 by \N

m.t: Por lo que yo sé, él nunca ha llegado a tiempo.
m.e: As far as I know, he has never come on time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #599358 by Shishir; English translation #471417 by CK

m.t: Lo digo de nuevo, nos ha llegado el momento.
m.e: I say again, our time has come.

m.t: Deben haber llegado a casa sobre esta hora.
m.e: They must have arrived home by this time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #862783 by felipeselles; English translation #306563 by CS

m.t: Si para entonces no ha llegado, la mataré.
m.e: If he does not arrive by then, I will kill her.

m.t: Él murió el día en que llegó su hijo.
m.e: He died on the day his son arrived.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1596442 by marcelostockle; English translation #300941 by CK

m.t: Él llegó el día que ella se fue.
m.e: He arrived the day she left.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #520731 by Shishir; English translation #308450 by CK

m.t: No tengo ni idea de cómo llegó allí.
m.e: I have no idea how it got there.

m.t: Él llegó cinco minutos más tarde de la hora señalada.
m.e: He came five minutes behind the appointed time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #871252 by washisnein; English translation #304298 by \N

m.t: El ataque llegó después de medianoche.
m.e: The attack came after midnight.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9150372 by Galko; English translation #5729875 by CM

m.t: Tu carta no me llegó hasta hoy.
m.e: Your letter didn't reach me until today.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3518262 by Aether; English translation #2958824 by sharptoothed

m.t: Lo único que podemos hacer es esperar a que llegue la policía.
m.e: All we can do is wait for the police to arrive.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1233169 by marcelostockle; English translation #953089 by CK

m.t: Llegue a casa, los escuché en su habitación.
m.e: Came home, heard them in their bedroom.

m.t: Te llamo en cuanto llegue a la estación.
m.e: I'll call you as soon as I get to the station.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9979290 by arh; English translation #9979286 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Te llamaré tan pronto como llegue a la estación.
m.e: I'll call you as soon as I get to the station.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9979292 by arh; English translation #9979286 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Estoy seguro de que te lo dirá en cuanto llegue.
m.e: I am sure he'll tell you as soon as he comes.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1602542 by teskmon; English translation #63344 by CK

m.t: No te olvides de avisarme cuando llegue el momento.
m.e: Don't forget to let me know when it's time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5854157 by arh; English translation #47018 by CK

m.t: Estoy haciendo tiempo hasta que llegue mi esposa.
m.e: I'm killing time until my wife arrives.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #13449653 by Seael; English translation #13554502 by araneo

m.t: ¿Cuándo se espera que llegue el próximo tren?
m.e: When is the next train expected to arrive?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #11353388 by carlosalberto; English translation #11353315 by carlosalberto

m.t: Cuando llegamos aquí, él ya se había ido.
m.e: When we arrived here, he had already left.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7633264 by mervert1; English translation #7633263 by mervert1

m.t: Llegamos aquí a las seis de la tarde ayer.
m.e: We arrived here at six yesterday evening.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2903658 by cueyayotl; English translation #247956 by CK

m.t: Para cuando llegamos allí, el barco ya se había ido.
m.e: By the time we got there, the ship had left.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #13975687 by mervert1; English translation #247190 by CK

m.t: Y llegamos 39 minutos hasta llegar al hospital.
m.e: And we got 39 minutes till we get to the hospital.

m.t: Si me preguntas, creo que llegamos demasiado tarde.
m.e: If you ask me, I think we came too late.

m.t: A este mundo llegamos solos, y así es como nos iremos.
m.e: We come into this world alone, and that’s how we’ll leave it.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10162492 by DJ_Saidez; English translation #10205446 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Casi no llegamos a tiempo a la iglesia.
m.e: We almost didn't make it to the church on time.

m.e: We reached an agreement at the end of the meeting.
